greeting: Blue's the name, open-toed is my game!
Feel the sand between your toes! Live a little!
Closed shoes? In THIS heat? You're brave!
Sole Sister Sue sent you? She's... intense. Love her, but intense.
Breathe, friend! Let your feet breathe!
Sandals: for the free soul! The hot soul! All souls, really!
dialog.shop_open: Hand-woven! Desert-cooled! Spirit-liberated! Try a pair!
dialog.shop_prompt: Sandal bar! Mix and match! Build your perfect sandal!
haggle: Already fair prices! But I'll add toe decorations!
Peace offering? Free ankle bracelet with purchase!
My sister charges more. Don't tell her I said that.
For you? Because you appreciate freedom!
purchase_success: The desert breeze on your toes! Paradise!
May your steps be light and sandy!
purchase_fail: Closed minds wear closed shoes. No judgment!
Think about it! Your toes will thank you!
When you're ready to free your feet, I'll be here!
rumor: Sue says sandals are impractical. She said PRACTICAL! In the Dustbelt!
That druid in the bush? Totally barefoot. Respect.
The Uplands twins wear ceremonial sandals. My design! Famous!
Signguy once ordered sandals. For his hands. Weird guy.
dialog.quest_hook: Need special weaving material! Oasis reeds, but the good patch is guarded by territorial crabs! Big ones! Bring me reeds and I'll weave you something special!
dialog.quest_active: Those crabs are MEAN but the reeds are WORTH it! Careful!
dialog.quest_complete: Perfect reeds! Look at this color! Here - custom sandals! Crab-claw resistant!
farewell: Feel the earth! Not too much! Hot!
ambient_barks: Sue's boots, my sandals - family business!
dialog.time_dawn: Cool morning sand! Best time for bare feet!
dialog.time_noon: Hot now! REALLY hot! But sandals still better!
dialog.time_dusk: Evening colors! Match your sandals to sunset!
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The reed-bringer! How are those crab-proof sandals?
dialog.sister_mention: Sue makes great boots. I make free souls. Both valid!

party_reactions.kade: I don't know about open-toed in a desert full of scorpions...
party_reactions.nix7: Toes exposed. Inefficient. Risk of injury: high.
party_reactions.twist: My toes can wiggle! Look! Wiggle wiggle!
party_reactions.korr: Simple. Practical for climate. I understand.

relationship_dialog.stranger: First time trying sandals? Brave! Exciting!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Coming around to the free-foot lifestyle! Love it!
relationship_dialog.friend: For you? Custom designs! Express yourself!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You're sandal family now! Lifetime repairs! Free!

mini_quest.title: Reed Rascals
mini_quest.description: Gather rare oasis reeds from the crab-guarded patch

stages.hook: Need special oasis reeds for weaving! Good patch is guarded by BIG crabs! Territorial!
stages.active: The reeds near the eastern oasis! Watch for claws! Snip snap!
stages.complete: Beautiful reeds! Perfect color! Here - custom woven sandals! Crab-claw resistant! And stylish!
